purpose: Teach: 行お/コンパイラ/スタック/アクセシビリティ/ラーニング/ウィークリー/インスピレーション/もうける

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、改革を実行に移し行おうとされた
lines.en: Father — when the company was founded, he moved forward with bringing about real change.
lines.style: Quiet, reverent recollection. Measured pace. Slight weight on the verbs of action. The tone of someone honoring a memory with care and precision.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは初期からコンパイラを社内に導入された
lines.en: Yes. From the very beginning, Father insisted on bringing in new systems himself.
lines.style: Steady affirmation. Gentle emphasis on 'himself'—pride in the father's hands-on approach. Warm, acknowledging tone without sentimentality.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、倉庫のスタック設計を自ら考えられた
lines.en: Father — he thought through the warehouse design with his own mind.
lines.style: Soft, deliberate. Pause before 'his own mind'—honoring the personal investment. The cadence of someone reflecting on a choice that mattered.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは商品のアクセシビリティを大事にされた
lines.en: Yes. Father truly valued making our products accessible to everyone.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. The words settle as principles, not anecdotes. Slight pause before the final phrase, as if holding the value itself.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、Eラーニングの可能性を早期に見抜かれた
lines.en: Father — he saw the possibility in e-learning long before anyone else did.
lines.style: Tender admiration. The opening word almost a sigh. Slow, deliberate pace. The tone of witnessing foresight in someone you deeply respected.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんはウィークリーで現場を訪ねられた
lines.en: Yes. Father visited the work site every week without fail.
lines.style: Simple, grounded statement. No flourish—the regularity itself speaks to dedication. Warm respect underlying each word.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、商品にインスピレーションを与える展示にこだわった
lines.en: Father — he was exacting about how products were displayed, believing presentation itself could inspire.
lines.style: Reverent pause before speaking. Careful articulation of 'inspire'—this wasn't casual attention but philosophy. Slow, honoring the particularity of the care.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは短期でもうける誘惑を退けられた
lines.en: Yes. Even when quick profit beckoned, Father turned away from that temptation.
lines.style: Firm, almost a closing benediction. Weight on 'turned away'—conviction, not regret. The final words carry the weight of principle held firm across time.
